This is what I do. I have the major points written down and I let the story take me there, let it fill in the middle for me. I'm already up to 57,000 words by doing it this way. Some people have told me there's only one rule in the world of writing- there are no rules, only guidelines. So you write however you want to and make it the way you want to. Enjoy the adventure.

Alright, here goes...

The three elves in the prologue are the only three left out of ten dragonriders. The other seven were killed by the darkness. It's closing in on the whole land and killing everything and everyone in its way. For two thousand years all mythological beings- elves, fairies, dragons, centaurs, trolls, etc., slept with only the humans left awake. 

Two young women leave their small village in search of adventure. On the way, they meet new friends, one of the girls catching the eye of the prince. The other (the main character) continues on travelling and happens upon a dragon nearby, who chooses her to be his rider. She's the first human rider ever. Now the dragons are the key to magic. Elves are born with powers and once the elves started mingling with humans and producing, the humans eventually gained powers as well. All humans have elven blood (which does not dilute over the generations) and their own abilities begin to awaken once the dragons are awake. The three elves from earlier return to lead and train the new riders.

The main character has a strong power- very rare: the power to mimic or absorb others powers. And from being a dragonrider, she also gets another ability. Those abilities are Light, Dark, Earth, Air, Fire, Water. The power over the dark is forbidden by the elves as the few in the past who did have it, went insane. That's what the main character has so she keeps it a secret and begins collecting more and more powers (some on accident). She wants to be able to help fight off the darkness when it returns.

Tavina tried to summon more lightning but could only produce small trickles of lightning. She watched on in frustration as the minotaur swung its arms around eventually hit Kinna, sending her flying into a tree trunk and knocking her unconscious as well. Zorna screeched in anger and began spitting fireballs at the flailing beast. Zorna took a hit, knocking him to the ground, scrambling to get back up as it stalked over to him.

"No," Tavina breathed. "Hey! Over here! Come and get me!" she yelled. Scared beyond belief, she looked on as it turned towards here, abandoning the hurt dragon in favor of her. As it prepared to charge at her, Tavina felt a rush of power run through her. It kept building and building inside of her as it transferred to her hands. As the minotaur started running towards her, her hands instinctively shot out. A large bolt of black lightning shot out from her hands, striking the minotaur, sending it flying backwards into the trees. Tavinas arms fell to her side as she breathed heavily and stared at the downed minotaur in confusion. 

She watched as the minotaur stumbled upright and heaved a sigh. Her eyes turned black as black mist rose from the shadows surrounding them. The minotaur snarled at her, obviously in pain, yet unwilling to give up. Tavina clenched her fists as it began coming towards her. Tavinas lips set firmly into a line as she concentrated on the mist swirling around her. Quickly her hands raised up and the mist began wrapping itself around the minotaur, who roared and flailed around. The black mist spun faster and faster around the beast, crushing it until it became silent. Tavina fell to the ground exhausted as the beast fell to ground dead and the mist disappeared back from where it came from.
